name: Listrak
description: Listrak provides email, SMS, cross-channel, data-import, privacy, mobile-push, and two-way messaging APIs.
agentUseSummary: Connect dedicated customer-owned Email REST client credentials. Relay pins four Email v1 operations: list inventory and exact-list reads run directly, an exact contact read and one-contact create/update require approval, the write requires contact authorization, and subscription additionally requires double-opt-in evidence.

credentialRequirements.name: LISTRAK_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Listrak client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated customer-owned Email REST integration with least-privilege List and Contact access.

credentialRequirements.name: LISTRAK_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Listrak client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay exchanges this only at the fixed Listrak token endpoint.

capabilities.label: Read lists
capabilities.description: Use the list inventory and exact-list configuration reads.

capabilities.label: Read contact
capabilities.description: Use one exact list/contact lookup with approval.

capabilities.label: Manage one contact
capabilities.description: Use one one-contact write with approval, authorization, and double-opt-in enforcement.

allowed.label: Read Listrak lists
allowed.description: Read the account list inventory or one exact list configuration.

approvalRequired.label: Read Listrak contact
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact email contact from one exact list.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Listrak contact
approvalRequired.description: Create or update one authorized contact with explicit subscription state.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Client credentials, access tokens, authorization headers, and credential-bearing response fields never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Run bulk or import APIs
blocked.description: Contact collections, list imports, profile-field bulk updates, exports, clickers/activity, and unbounded transfers are excluded.

blocked.label: Send or administer campaigns
blocked.description: Message/transactional sends, campaigns, content, lists, events, conversations, saved audiences, profile-field administration, and deletes remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only four pinned Email v1 routes run on fixed token/API origins; unsubscribe overrides, arbitrary paths, queries, fields, URLs, headers, and oversized results are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: List reads run directly; exact contact reads and one-contact writes require approval, writes require contact authorization, and subscription additionally requires double-opt-in evidence.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All four selected operations run without Relay per-action approval; authorization/double-opt-in attestations, fixed routing, bounds, audits, and bulk/send/admin blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts four pinned Listrak Email v1 routes and performs a fixed client-credentials exchange without exposing secrets or tokens.

providerSetup.blocker: Listrak requires a customer-owned least-privilege Email REST integration, client credentials, lists, and permission-based contact acquisition. No console, integration/app, credentials, list, contact, consent, Railway environment, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a dedicated staging Email REST integration outside this worker with only List and Contact access, configure credentials in Railway staging, and verify token exchange, list/contact reads, approval and contact/double-opt-in denial/allow, subscribe/unsubscribe behavior without override, response bounds, secret rotation, pause/disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Listrak's downloadable current Email REST contract documents the fixed API/token origins, client-credentials bearer flow, List and Contact scopes, exact v1 routes, contact schema, and subscription safety parameters.
Listrak documents REST method semantics and distinct Email, SMS, Cross Channel, Data Import, Two-Way SMS, Mobile Push, and Privacy API families.
Listrak's developer hub identifies the Email REST API for contacts, campaigns, and performance and links the separate API families excluded by Relay.
Listrak documents lawful use, privacy, data-transfer, security, and prohibited-content obligations for its messaging service.
